details: It is sufficient to query all coordinates in the distinguishing range.
proof: Let $S$ be a smallest coordinate set on which the concepts of $\mathcal{H}$ have pairwise distinct restrictions.  Querying the target on every coordinate in $S$ determines its restriction to $S$, and hence identifies the target.  Therefore $\mathrm{Q}_m(\mathcal{H})\le |S|=\mathrm{R}(\mathcal{H})$.
name: Distinguishing Range / Membership Query Complexity
